column3: Bulk import of catalogue items via CSV
column4: As a catalogue librarian I want to upload new items as a CSV so that I do not have to enter them one by one.
column5:
- The upload accepts CSV files with between 1 and 5000 rows
- A row with an invalid ISBN is rejected and the line number is shown in the error report
- Only users with the role Catalogue Maintenance may open the upload dialog
Given a valid file with 120 rows
When the librarian confirms the upload
Then the new items are visible in the catalogue within one minute

column3: Availability shown directly in the hit list
column4: Staff should see an item's status without opening it.
column5:
- The hit list shows Available, On loan or Missing for every item
- For an item on loan the return date is shown as well
- Items without a shelf mark show the status Unknown

column3: A loan can still be renewed after it was returned
column4: After a return the Renew button is still shown but the renewal silently fails.
column5:
- The Renew button is hidden as soon as the status changes from On loan to Returned
- A loan in status On loan can still be renewed
- Renewing moves the return date two weeks later
